skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Before Singing
skins.content: The Legend of Luo Xiaohei Collaborative Series/Before Singing. Glossy texturing and a bright palette make for materials that shout energy, while contour-hugging innerwear pairs with a loose-fit jacket to provide both comfort and chic.
skins.quote: Rockrock's endlessly enthused about picking out a present for her new friend, but when the next welcoming activity is—singing twelve straight songs with Xiaohei? That's got her a little awkward.
